summary: Configured and validated a persistent six-path, key-only SSH mesh for clusterops across node1, node2, and node3.
actions_performed: Generated per-node SSH credentials and host keys.
Configured peer-only authorized_keys restrictions, stable hostname resolution, known_hosts, and non-interactive SSH client settings.
Installed OPERATIONS.md on all three nodes.
Verified all six peer connections and denied self-source access.
